pages.title: What the Relay Was Doing
pages.text: Changing flow is normal, not a fault. A relay balances connected stores by charge percentage, so it has no single fixed OP/t rating; flow naturally changes with charge and free space at both ends.

pages.title: Tiers and Limits
pages.text: Measured limits:$(br2)$(bold)Draconium:$() 4M OP, 8 links, 32 blocks.$(br)$(bold)Wyvern:$() 16M OP, 16 links, 64 blocks.$(br)$(bold)Draconic:$() 64M OP, 32 links, 127 blocks.$(br2)When in doubt, watch whether energy at the connected stores actually changes.

pages.title: Draconic Relay
pages.text: The Draconic Relay is a Fusion upgrade, so its arrangement cannot be drawn in an ordinary crafting frame. It carries the largest link count and range recorded above.
